"Insecurity-obliterating anthems by pop’s most human superstar: Beyond the sleaze, grinding bass and it-girl in-jokes, the British visionary’s sixth album is a masterpiece that understands how a hard persona can offer protection."
- The Guardian

"English pop singer-songwriter Charli XCX ‘s sixth album, Brat, oscillates between hedonism and anxiety — the euphoria of a late night on the dancefloor and the creeping disquietude of the morning after — as much as it does her in-between status as pop queen of the underground and sometimes mainstream success story."
- AP News

Pop icon Charli xcx releases new reworked album Brat and it’s completely different but also still brat, a remixed deluxe edition of her groundbreaking album BRAT. The album contains remixes of tracks from her sixth studio album, Brat, and serves as a double album, also featuring the original and deluxe tracks. Guests include Robyn, Yung Lean, BB Trickz, Ariana Grande, the 1975, Jon Hopkins, Troye Sivan, Addison Rae, Caroline Polachek, Bladee, Lorde, the Japanese House, Tinashe, Julian Casablancas, Bon Iver, Shygirl, Billie Eilish, and A. G. Cook, of which some contributed production to multiple songs on Brat.
